title: ChipBlocks shuttles manifest
description: Single source of truth for fab targets — FPGA boards + ASIC shuttle tiers. Per ADR-005 (../ADR-005-modular-fab-platform.md), this file is authored at repo root. The codegen scripts produce the BuildTarget TS union + the ALL_BOARDS registry in build.py + the active-cohort metadata in tinytapeout.py from this manifest. Adding a new shuttle is 1 row here + 1 adapter at backend/shuttles/<id>.py.

id.description: Shuttle id used as the --target argparse choice, BuildTarget union member, and BUILD_TARGETS array key. Lowercase, hyphens allowed.

label.description: Display label shown in the build dropdown.

kind.description: fpga-board produces a flashable bitstream; asic-shuttle produces a submission package for a fab service.

chip_family.description: FPGA path only: nextpnr-ice40 family flag value (hx1k, lp8k, up5k).

fpga_package.description: FPGA path only: nextpnr-ice40 --package value (tq144, cm81, sg48).

clock_hz.description: Onboard or shuttle-side clock frequency in Hz.

clock_pin.description: FPGA path only: pin label for the global clock input (numeric for TQ144/SG48, alphanumeric like 'B2' for CM81).

audio_pin.description: FPGA path only: pin label for the PWM-modulated audio output.

vga_pins.description: FPGA path only: optional VGA pin map (vga_r/g/b/hsync/vsync -> physical pin). Set only on boards with a documented standard VGA PMOD convention (today only iCEBreaker).

pdk.description: ASIC path only: FK into pdks.yaml (e.g. 'sky130A').

package.description: ASIC path only: FK into packages.yaml (e.g. 'caravel-mux').

flow.description: FK into flows.yaml (e.g. 'yosys-nextpnr-ice40' for FPGA, 'openlane-tt' for Tiny Tapeout).

area.description: ASIC path only: physical area + transistor budget for the shuttle tier.

tiles.description: ASIC path only: number of tiles per design (1 = single tile, 2+ = chained tiles via inter-tile bus).

top_module_prefix.description: ASIC path only: required Verilog top-module prefix (e.g. 'tt_um_' for Tiny Tapeout).

submission.description: ASIC path only: where + when to submit. cohort_closes is ISO-8601 date or 'rolling' or 'TBD'.

free_for_open_source.description: True if open-source designs get free shuttle slots (e.g. via the eFabless Open Shuttle Program).

estimated_cost_usd.description: Estimated cost per chip in USD; 0 for fully-free open-source-eligible shuttles.

adapter_path.description: Path to the Python adapter for this shuttle. Today the existing FPGA boards point at build.py and the TT slot points at tinytapeout.py; per-shuttle adapter directories land as new tiers do.

notes.description: Free-form notes — provenance, pinout caveats, BOM tips.
